lines.text: Say aren't you, not isn't it!
Many learners say: You are a teacher, isn't it?
Better: You are a teacher, aren't you?
End with a short question that fits.
Isn't she! She is tired, isn't she?

data.wrong: You are a teacher, isn't it?
data.right: You are a teacher, aren't you?
data.why: End with a short question that fits.

native.hook: ถามย้ำ ต้องตรงกับประโยค!
native.tip: ภาษาไทยลงท้ายถามย้ำว่า “ใช่ไหม” ได้ทุกประโยค จึงมักพูด isn't it แต่ภาษาอังกฤษต้องเปลี่ยนตามประโยค: “You are a teacher, aren't you?”
native.caption: คุณเคยพูดว่า “You are a teacher, isn't it?” ไหม? 😅 ภาษาไทยลงท้ายถามย้ำว่า “ใช่ไหม” ได้ทุกประโยค จึงมักพูด isn't it แต่ภาษาอังกฤษต้องเปลี่ยนตามประโยค: “You are a teacher, aren't you?” ฟังครู Carlos แล้วพูดตามนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มในแอป Lexkite

en.hook: Make the ending fit the sentence!
en.tip: Thai uses one short ending for every sentence, so people say isn't it each time, but English changes it to fit the sentence.
en.caption: Do you say “You are a teacher, isn't it?” 😅 Thai uses one short ending for every sentence, so people say isn't it each time, but English changes it to fit the sentence. Say “You are a teacher, aren't you?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
